name: Alpha Bulk: 90-Day Muscle Mass Protocol
description:
A 90-day, 3-phase hypertrophy program built for maximum muscle growth from minimum time in the gym — 3 full-body-split sessions a week, deliberately low volume, so you still have the recovery capacity for martial arts or combat sports training at least twice weekly.

The method: mechanical tension — not endless sets — is what actually drives growth. Every set is taken close to true failure with a strict 3-0-3-0 tempo (3 seconds down, no pause, 3 seconds up, no pause) to maximize time under tension. Fewer, harder sets beat more, easier ones.

Phase 1 (Weeks 1-4): Foundation. Learn the tempo, build the mind-muscle connection, establish your working weights.

Phase 2 (Weeks 5-7): Escalation. Same low volume, more technical/unilateral exercise variety, pushed closer to true failure on every set.

Week 8: Deload. Same movement patterns, roughly half the effort — this is what makes Phase 3 sustainable instead of a burnout risk. Don't skip it.

Phase 3 (Weeks 9-13): Peak Intensity. Train the last set of key lifts to true failure, with one drop set worked in on the hardest day — still only 3 sessions a week, still room for your combat training.

Form notes: engage the target muscle before you move, keep tension constant through the whole rep, and breathe in a steady rhythm — never hold your breath through a slow rep. Rest 2-3 minutes between compound lifts (squats, presses, rows, deadlifts), 1.5-2 minutes between isolation work — recovery between sets is what keeps every rep high-quality, not wasted time.
